text:
ada-partnerships: Heads-up team — CloudVendorX marketplace onboarding: they want a minimal, audited Terraform starter that demonstrates k8s inference + autoscaling + private networking. We need a single repo layout, cross-cloud examples (GCP/AWS), and a short ops runbook for partner review. Any volunteers to draft structure?

josh-eng: I can start the repo layout. My thoughts: modules/ (network, cluster, vault-integration, inference), examples/ (aws, gcp), docs/ (arch.md, runbook.md), CI/ (tfsec + terratest). Keep modules provider-agnostic (no provider {}), use variables for project/account.

priya-arch: +1. Constraints: 1) support both Dedicated and Hosted routing (so inference module needs routing_mode var), 2) optional HSM/KMS integration toggles, 3) firewall blocks for private customer VPC. For diagrams i'll drop an initial sketch in docs/arch.md.

sam-terraform: I'll own Terraform module scaffolding. Quick checklist for each module: variables.tf, outputs.tf, README.md (usage + example). For examples include top-level terragrunt.hcl? maybe keep plain terraform first. Also agree no provider blocks.

ada-partnerships: Nice. Timeline: scaffolding by EOD tomorrow, review on Thursday. Partner asks for a short sample showing how to disable autoscaler (for latency-sensitive workloads) — add an example flag.

josh-eng: Note about outputs: cluster_endpoint, kubeconfig_raw, node_pool_names, network_id. Also include a outputs_security_group for cloud-specific examples.

priya-arch: Docs acceptance criteria: 1) architecture diagram, 2) instructions to enable KMS + HSM fallback, 3) security checklist for marketplace (IAM, least privilege, artifact scanning), 4) cost estimate notes for demo setup.

sam-terraform: I'll open PR with scaffolding + example wiring network->cluster->inference. PR will include a sample main.tf snippet:

```
module "network" {
  source = "../modules/network"
  name   = "cvx-demo-net"
  region = var.region
}
module "cluster" {
  source = "../modules/cluster"
  network_id = module.network.id
  cluster_name = "cvx-demo"
}
module "inference" {
  source = "../modules/inference"
  cluster_name = module.cluster.name
  routing_mode = var.routing_mode
  enable_hsm = var.enable_hsm
}
```

ops-bot: CI pipeline template created: https://ci.internal/redwood/cvx-iac (scan + unit tests) :white_check_mark:

ada-partnerships: Perfect. Action items: sam PR, josh to add outputs lint rule to repo template, priya to drop arch diagram + security checklist in docs/arch.md. Will schedule partner walkthrough next Fri. :calendar:
